text:
Amazing Dental Clinic! Great doctor and staff and nurses are nice and kind. Just went in for a tooth that cracked straight down the side from something I ate earlier and the dentist was able to remove this part entirely and fill in the area. Also filled in another cavity for me I had afterward.

Very grateful and would highly recommend this shop. A++ service

restaurant_name: Siamsmile Pattaya - คลินิกทันตกรรมสยามสไมล์ พัทยา
text: Thanks and you really helped save my vacation. I was on vacation from Japan and my zirconia molar inlay fell out while (foolishly) chewing on some coconut candy.  I explained to the dentist to just put some temporary filling to keep my molar safe until my Japan based dentist re-inserted the inlay when I got back (and that went successfully).  Pattaya is one of the best places in the world to enjoy food and I was able to continue to enjoy my culinary adventure safely when the dentist took no more than five minutes to complete this simple procedure. Just 1,000 baht and I was on my way. Thanks again and if something dental comes up on a future Pattaya vacation you will see me again!

restaurant_name: Siamsmile Pattaya - คลินิกทันตกรรมสยามสไมล์ พัทยา
text: I recently had a really big filling crack in half, on a recommendation I came to siam smile, I had an initial consultation, examination and xray, I was told that the tooth could be filled or a crown put on it, I decided to go for the zirconia crown, the dentist started the work immediately and I left 1 hour later with a temporary crown on, the dentist and his assistants were very good, I returned 5 days later to have the zirconia crown on, the whole process was pain free and I felt I was in very good professional hands, its now been on a week and I couldn't be more pleased, thank you siam smile

restaurant_name: Siamsmile Pattaya - คลินิกทันตกรรมสยามสไมล์ พัทยา
text:
I had a bad experience at this dental clinic and will never come back.

Doctor had asked me before starting the Teeth whitening procedure that the color of the 02 front composite teeth that I have will not be similar to the teeth that will be made white and I agreed to it.

After 40 minutes treatment when I saw the final result,the composite teeth which were in the front were absolute yellow and all other teeth were white. As a doctor she should have explained but in a rush to make some money, they quickly did the procedure and upon completion I was absolutely hurt by the staff treatment.

When I asked them why the composite teeth have not been treated at all they were all laughing ( 03 of the female staff ) as if it was a joke to them.

The doctor from other cabin shoutingly said " mister i told you before and you said ok"

Suddenly from the patient Initially who was treated well I was being treated as if I was bothering them.

I have done several tooth procedures for last 17 years and I know, how few things work.

In the end I paid and left totally upset but all they had to say was you bill is 4500 bhat.

I hope other people are careful and do their treatment somewhere else.

I dont wish to sound harsh as everyone is doing their job but as a doctor she needs to learn to atleast try to fix if something goes not as per a patient liking and not just offer more and more treatment to just make extra money.

text:

This is definitely the BEST dental work I have ever had in my entire life.
Thank you
